variants.name: Handcart
variants.solidity: solid (static prop; can be a physics prop)
variants.collider: box for the body (1.3 x 1.4 x 0.6 at floor level), 2 thin boxes/cylinders for the wheels, 2 thin boxes for the shafts (or one convex hull overall)
variants.notes: Modelled: floor 5 planks (one long-cracked), side walls 2+2, front wall with broken upper plank + splinters, low back plank, 4 corner posts, 16 pegs, 4 iron corner brackets, ~60 nails (body, wheel faces, wheel treads), axle, 2 sills, 2 shafts with iron straps and rope grip wraps + loose ends, 2 faceted solid wheels with hex hubs, iron hub caps and linchpins, nailed patch, cracks/chips, seeds/husks/leaves/needles/clod left in the bed, wheel chock + stone, ground litter. Empty body; seeds/sacks are separate assets. Damaged variant = rotate/chip a wheel in the level.
